module: Feeds the interface's "controls legend" app (bindings legend). It groups sets of actions (named by a label and ranked by priority) and sends them to the UI via `setActionsForLegend`: actions tied to held modifiers (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, modifier1 to 6), vehicle-specific actions, basic driving controls and constant actions. A modder or another module uses it to display its own actions on screen with addActions. Depends on `core_input_actions` and `core_input_bindings`.
notes: Each action set is identified by its label; addActions replaces the existing set with the same label. Priorities seen in the code: modifiers 9, vehicleSpecific 10 (shown on demand) or 8 (ephemeral after a vehicle change), constant actions 10. If a set has a priority, only the sets with the maximum priority are sent to the UI.

`additionalData.ttl` (real seconds) removes the set automatically in onUpdate; `removeIfOverwrittenWithHigherPriority` cancels the addition if a set of higher priority already exists; `resetFade` is true by default.

Each action receives `inputActionOnClick = true` by default and, without `label`, the title of the active action (`core_input_actions.getActiveActions()[action].title`): an unknown action would cause an error on nil.
At most `actionLimit = 50` is defined as a constant; the Shift-only combination is filtered (actions marked `hidden`).
shouldFade() always returns false: the automatic hiding after 7 s (fadeDelaySeconds) is disabled in this version, the original code being commented out.

onInputBindingsChanged and onPlayerVehicleDataChanged are local; only onPlayerVehicleDataChanged is exported (under the names onVehicleSpawned and onVehicleResetted). onInputBindingsChanged is not exported, so never called as a hook: the file does not react to this bindings change (inferred from code).

The always-shown actions (actionsToAlwaysShow) are notably toggleWalkingMode, activateStarterMotor, toggleShowVehicleSpecificActions, toggle_slow_motion, toggleShowBindingsLegendApp, nodegrabberPadMode and switch_next_vehicle; the file `ui/bindingAppActions.json` is read on load.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: core_input_actions and core_input_bindings.

addActions.desc: Adds (or replaces) an action set shown in the legend, then sends the data to the UI. An empty set simply removes the old set with the same label.

label.desc: Name of the action set (replacement key).

actions.desc: Actions; each entry has at least `action` (input action name) and optionally `label`, `inputActionOnClick`.

additionalData.desc: Options: priority, ttl, removeIfOverwrittenWithHigherPriority, resetFade, modifiersActive…

sendDataToUI.desc: Merges the action sets (keeping those of highest priority), adds modifier info and the `showApp` state, then sends everything to the UI via the `setActionsForLegend` hook.

forceResetFade.desc: Forces the hiding delay to reset.

toggleShowVehicleSpecificActions.desc: Shows or hides the actions specific to the player's vehicle.

enableShowVehicleSpecificActions.desc: Enables or disables the display of vehicle-specific actions (priority 10). No effect if the app is hidden in the settings, if the requested state is already active, or if the vehicle has no such actions.

showToggleVehicleSpecificActionsMessage.desc: Shows two UI messages (`Message`, 10 s) indicating how to display the vehicle's actions, one for gamepad and one for keyboard. Ignored during the first-drive experience or if the app is hidden.

setDebug.desc: Enables or disables the "BindingsLegend Debug" ImGui window (hiding delay, fade state).

setShowBasicDrivingControls.desc: Enables or disables the display of basic driving controls (`basicDriving` set), updated according to the gearbox mode.

triggerInputAction.desc: Executes an input action as if it were triggered, on player 0's vehicle (called from the UI when an action is clicked).

toggleShowApp.desc: Toggles the `bindingsLegendShowApp` setting, hides the vehicle actions, resets the timer and sends the data back to the UI.

onModifierChanged.desc: Hook called when the held modifier keys change. Searches, among the bindings of recent devices, for the actions whose modifiers match exactly and shows them as the `modified` set (priority 9).

newModifiers.desc: Bit mask: 1 Left Shift, 2 Right Shift, 4 Left Ctrl, 8 Right Ctrl, 16 Left Alt, 32 Right Alt, 64 to 2048 modifier1 to modifier6.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame. Advances the fade timer, refreshes the basic driving controls (gearbox mode change), counts down the `ttl` of the action sets and shows the debug window. Exits early if there is no player vehicle.

dtSim.desc: Simulation time delta in seconds (not used).

onActionFilterUpdated.desc: Hook called when the action filter changes. Invalidates the caches and sends the data back to the UI.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called at the start of a mission/level. Does nothing.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a mission/level. Empties the action sets and caches, and unregisters the gearbox modes.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload. Starts a job that invalidates the modifier actions cache.

onDeviceChanged.desc: Hook called when the input device changes. Invalidates the caches and sends the data back to the UI.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads. Reads `ui/bindingAppActions.json` and computes the vehicle's available actions.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the settings change. Resets the signature of the basic controls and sends the data back to the UI.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is reset. Same function as onVehicleSpawned: if it is player 0's vehicle (or without an id), invalidates the caches and sends the data back to the UI.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is spawned. See onVehicleResetted.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes. Recomputes the vehicle's actions and, if it has any, briefly shows them (`vehicleSpecific` set, ttl 10 s) with a help message.
